== Documentation ==
The documentation comments for this script come from the <code>DefaultAliasOnItemAddedScript.psc</code> source file.

<source>
Sets quest stage when items are added to this Alias.
<QuestToSetOrCheck> is THIS Alias's GetOwningQuest()
<RefToCheck> is the PLAYER.
<LocationToCheck> is the current location of THIS alias.
